# This workflow runs btcRecover tests inside a Termux container via QEMU.
# It tests both the base requirements (requirements.txt) and the full requirements (requirements-full.txt).
# The workflow runs on pull requests and on a weekly schedule.

name: Termux Tests

on:
  pull_request:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 0'  # every Sunday at 00:00 UTC

jobs:
  base-tests:
    name: Base Requirements Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up QEMU
        uses: docker/setup-qemu-action@v3

      - name: Run tests in Termux container
        run: |
          docker run --rm \
            -v ${{ github.workspace }}:/workspace \
            -w /workspace \
            termux/termux-docker \
            bash -c "apt-get update && apt-get install -y python3 python3-pip && \
                     pip3 install -r requirements.txt && \
                     python3 run-all-tests.py -vv --no-pause --no-buffer"

  full-tests:
    name: Full Requirements Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: base-tests
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up QEMU
        uses: docker/setup-qemu-action@v3

      - name: Run tests in Termux container with full requirements
        run: |
          docker run --rm \
            -v ${{ github.workspace }}:/workspace \
            -w /workspace \
            termux/termux-docker \
            bash -c "apt-get update && apt-get install -y python3 python3-pip && \
                     pip3 install -r requirements-full.txt && \
                     python3 run-all-tests.py -vv --no-pause --no-buffer"
